scope: Public prices for low-unit payment-capable wearable hardware versus cheaper NFC building blocks
currency_note: USD unless explicitly marked EUR; no exchange-rate conversion applied

payment_capable_candidates.name: Infineon SECORA Pay W, SPA 2.1 insert or USON8-7 package
payment_capable_candidates.price_status: Supplier quote required; no verified public low-unit chip/module listing
payment_capable_candidates.capability: Pre-certified Visa/Mastercard solution for passive payment wearables; delivered as payment insert or packaged chip, still requiring antenna/form-factor integration, provisioning, issuer eligibility and program terms

payment_capable_candidates.name: STMicroelectronics STPay-Topaz-1 payment platform
payment_capable_candidates.price_status: ST official product page shows no budgetary price and no distributor availability; contact sales for quotation
payment_capable_candidates.capability: Payment-oriented secure MCU/software platform; not a retail-provisioned wearable by itself

payment_capable_candidates.name: NXP PN80T integrated NFC plus embedded secure element
payment_capable_candidates.price_status: No verified authorized-distributor low-unit USD price found
payment_capable_candidates.capability: Integrated NFC/SE chip family used in payment-capable wearables; wallet software, scheme approvals, issuer/card provisioning and antenna design are separate

low_cost_but_not_payment_credentials.name: NXP PN7160A1HN/C100E NFC controller
low_cost_but_not_payment_credentials.limitation: NXP explicitly says PN7160/PN7161 are not intended/designed for applications requiring EMVCo 3.x analog/digital compliance. Do not call it a wallet/payment solution.

low_cost_but_not_payment_credentials.name: NXP SE050E2HQ1/Z01Z3Z Plug & Trust secure element
low_cost_but_not_payment_credentials.limitation: IoT secure element; this listing does not include payment applets, issuer-provisioned credentials or certification. Combining it with an NFC controller does not yield an approved payment credential.

consumer_validation_item.name: Fidesmo Pay payment keyring, complete consumer product
consumer_validation_item.limitation: Finished keyring, not loose chip, insert, board or custom-device BOM price; card compatibility and geography must be checked.

conclusion: No defensible public low-unit USD price was found for a purchasable, provisionable Visa/Mastercard wearable payment chip or insert. The £99 USC samples pack is a multi-item evaluation pack, not the price of payment silicon. Do not substitute public prices for NFC readers, NFC tags, or generic IoT secure elements as payment hardware.
